messages:
lee (eng-sre): Postmortem INC-1827 posted. Root cause summary: KV eviction cascade + autoscaler lag. Need runbook fixes and clear owners.

lee (eng-sre): Proposed actions:
- Add a KV health triage block (owner: tara, due: 2025-05-11)
- Add containment 'safe-mode' commands + diagnostics (owner: jon, due: 2025-05-13)
- Make autoscaler-failure escalation explicit (owner: ash, due: 2025-05-09)
- Tag incident pattern for 30d trend and monthly digest (owner: lee, due: 2025-05-20)

tara (eng-platform): Ill take KV triage. Will include queries for hit ratio, eviction rate, and a quick revert toggle.

jon (eng-runtime): Taking safe-mode. Draft for runbook snippet:

```
# safe-mode: reduce concurrency and flip cache to readonly
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-api --replicas=1
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/inference-api KV_CACHE_MODE=readonly
kubectl -n inference exec deploy/inference-api -- python -m redwood.tools.kv_dump --recent-evictions=20
```

jon (eng-runtime): Will add example outputs so oncall can grep.

ash (infra): For escalation ladder: @oncall-sre -> @platform-pager if no ack in 5m -> page infra lead @ash after 15m -> exec manager after 30m. I'll add rotation links.

runbook-bot: Draft runbook created by tara: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction-draft PR #481.

tara (eng-platform): PR has checklist and sample queries. pinging @ash and @jon for review.

lee (eng-sre): Scheduling 25m walkthrough for oncall to go over new steps on 2025-05-08 16:00 UTC. runbook-bot set reminder.

runbook-bot: Reminder set: runbook walkthrough 2025-05-08 16:00 UTC (invite sent).

jon (eng-runtime): One flag: we should avoid auto-fallback to lower-capacity model in runbook. I'll open an Optimize ticket.

lee (eng-sre): Agreed. Keep runbook focused on triage/containment. Optimize ticket welcome.

tara (eng-platform): After walkthrough I'll merge the PR and update the runbook header with postmortem link and recurring-pattern tag.

lee (eng-sre): Thanks everyone. Reply here if you need to shift due dates.
